question:
Select the figure from the options that can replace the question mark (?) and complete the given pattern.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c7b4930178ba310a845a664aa5ed53955643a4647fdc149e2ff0623f7c67df72.png]
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

1) In the first row B, and O are interchanged positions with L, T respectively, In the second row every figure shifted one place to the right side in the second figure, In the third row all the are written in reverse order in the second figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a511b3d8a945e4dd59aa557241787c774cbaa84625e8382e4d485496561fbb0d.png] 

2) L, B and T,O are shifted diagonally with V,C and = , 8 Respectively. In Second row 1st pair and last pair are interchanged their position mutually.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a9b4e4e3cc90a12febd01b76f6f3b8b2941747e9b08e227f1603c9f77807dce.png] 

3)In the first row C, and V are interchanged positions with 8, = respectively, In the second row every figure shifted one place to the right side in the fourth figure, In the third row all the are written in reverse order in the fourth figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b4ced45c47eb84f7c0cdd25300d4d7c757e6b7f943e9baca66920b82716b9f3a.png] 

4) V, C and =,8 are shifted diagonally with T,O and L, B Respectively. In Second row 1st pair and last pair are interchanged their position mutually.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af188877098902b0fb6729a50e02a8a0056b4ec61762017a759bda457ea1bcc1.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
